data.standardized_narrative: Gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2020 were $663.748m. Based on the syndicate's gross claims development table, there was effectively no material prior-year movement for underwriting years prior to 2019 (no net strengthenings or releases quantified). The business experienced COVID-19 related claims and an above-average natural catastrophe year in 2020, but these related primarily to the 2019/2020 years of account rather than producing measurable prior-year reserve movement on older years.
raw_causal_phrases: impacted by claims as a result of Covid-19
multiple landfalling hurricanes in the United States
Adjustments to the amounts of claims provisions established in prior years are reflected in the financial statements for the period in which the adjustments are made.
The directors consider that the provisions for gross claims and related reinsurance recoveries are fairly stated on the basis of the information currently available to them.
data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Balance Sheet 'Claims outstanding' (prior year comparative). Prior-year development derived from the gross claims development table (gross triangle) which shows no change between the previous diagonal and current estimates for underwriting years <=2018, resulting in a zero PYD. No explicit narrative quantifying gross prior-year movement was found. All main monetary amounts converted from report $'000 to millions (USD). Triangle is presented in thousands in the report; triangle units retained as 'thousands' in _claims_triangle.
